changePassword.placeholderKeepCurrent: Leave blank to keep your current password
changePassword.placeholderAddPassword: Add a password so you can also sign in without Google
changePassword.confirmCurrentRequired: Enter your current password to set a new one
changePassword.updatedButSessionsNotRevokedToast: Password updated, but we couldn't sign out your other sessions. Try Manage Sessions.

accountStatus.hasPasswordDescription: You can sign in with your email and password. If this email is also linked to a Google account, Google sign-in works too.
accountStatus.noPasswordDescription: This account currently signs in with Google only. Use the Change Password card to also enable email/password sign-in.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Pick a custom brand color for your account. It's saved to your account and applies to buttons, links, and your logo everywhere you sign in.
appearance.contrastWarning: This color may be hard to read on buttons and links. Consider a darker shade for better contrast.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Deleting your account deactivates it immediately and signs you out everywhere. It stays recoverable by an administrator for a short grace period, after which it's permanently and irreversibly removed.
deleteAccount.oauthOnlyDescription: Deleting your account requires confirming by email. Once you confirm, it deactivates immediately and signs you out everywhere. It stays recoverable by an administrator for a short grace period, after which it's permanently and irreversibly removed.
deleteAccount.currentPasswordRequired: Enter your current password to delete your account
deleteAccount.confirmDescription: This deactivates your account and signs you out everywhere right away. It can still be recovered by an administrator during the grace period, but after that it's permanently deleted and cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.oauthOnlyConfirmDescription: We'll email you a confirmation link. Your account isn't deleted until you click it - clicking it deactivates your account and signs you out everywhere right away. It can still be recovered by an administrator during the grace period, but after that it's permanently deleted and cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.confirmationEmailSent: Check your email for a link to confirm deleting your account. The link will expire after a while, so confirm soon if you want to proceed.

confirmDeletePage.heading: Confirm Account Deletion
confirmDeletePage.subtitle: Click the button below to permanently confirm you want to delete your account.
